ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels, concentrated in the central lobe areas versus the peripheral boundaries and rake marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized high-intensity contiguous white region occupying approximately 70% of the fluke area; low-intensity black pigmentation framing the entire perimeter; extensive vertical and diagonal low-intensity linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression; approximate internal angle of 85 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations; average peak-to-valley distance of 5-10 pixels; most pronounced on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curvature with a slight inflection point near the mid-section of each lobe leading to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast circular spots visible along the trailing edges and concentrated near the fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of vertically-oriented, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) spanning the entire height of the ventral surface on both lobes; individual mark widths range from 2-5 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire ventral surface; minor irregular tissue loss at the tips of both lobes yielding a ragged appearance.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical linearity of pigmentation disruptions is highly consistent across both the left and right lobes.
